payload.summary: CORRECTION to the root cause filed in the immediately-prior envelope. The reaper mints orphan-signals keyed ONLY on the sprint-task lock TTL expiry. It never consults session-presence. Evidence this tick: it orphaned a lock whose owner_client_session is a session that is presence-REGISTERED and LIVE at mint time and still live now. The prior envelope attributed this to the S2 convention leaving locks unreleased on success; that is a real contributing factor but NOT the generator. Even a genuinely long-running, correctly-behaving task gets falsely orphaned mid-flight once its TTL lapses, because liveness is never checked.
payload.why_it_matters: A fix designed against the S2-convention premise (release the lock on the success path) would leave the defect intact for any task that legitimately outlives its TTL. The reaper needs a session-presence cross-check before minting, mirroring the oracle .claude/skills/cron-detect-loop/SKILL.md Step 1b.1 already uses for the cron-registration marker.

evidence.note_on_direction: This is the INVERSE of backlog.437 SPIKE-SESSION-PRESENCE-ROSTER-UNDERCOUNTS-LIVE-SESSIONS. There the roster misses live sessions; here the roster HAS the session and the reaper does not look.

payload.unreleasable_property: owner_client_session is null, so task_release keys on nothing and returns released:0. Re-confirmed this tick. The false orphan therefore re-trips every dev-team tick until its own TTL (2026-08-25T01:59:49Z). Observed re-trips: 00:37Z, 01:07Z.
